content: रञ्ज् €1 €4 <ab>U.</ab> (रजति-ते, रज्यति-ते, रक्त; {%<ab>pass.</ab>%} रज्यते; {%<ab>desid.</ab>%} रिरंक्षति) .²1 To be dyed or coloured, to redden, become red, glow; कोपरज्यन्मुखश्रीः <ls>U. 5. 3</ls>; नेत्रे स्वयं रज्यतः <ls n="U.">5. 36</ls>; <ls>N. 3. 120</ls>, <ls n="N.">7. 60</ls>, <ls n="N.">22. 52</ls>. .²2 To dye, tinge, colour, paint. .²3 To be attached or devoted to (with <ab>loc.</ab>). देवानियं निषधराजरुचस्त्यजन्ती रूपादरज्यत नले न विदर्भसुभ्रूः <ls>N. 13. 38</ls>; <ls>S. D. 111</ls>. .²4 To be enamoured of, fall in love with, feel passion or affection for. .²5 To be pleased, satisfied, or delighted. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (रञ्जयतिते) .²1 To dye, tinge, colour, redden, paint; सा रञ्जयित्वा चरणौ कृताशीः <ls>Ku. 7. 19</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">6. 81</ls>; <ls>Ki. 1. 40</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">4. 14</ls>. .²2 To please, gratify, propitiate, satisfy; ज्ञानलवदुर्विदग्धं ब्रह्मापि नरं न रञ्जयति <ls>Bh. 2. 3</ls>; (रजयति also in this sense; see <ls>Ki. 6. 25</ls>); स्फुरतु कुचकुम्भयोरुपरि मणिमञ्जरी रञ्जयतु तव हृदयदेशम् <ls>Gīt. 10</ls>. .²3 To conciliate, win over, keep contented; समीक्ष्य स धृतः सम्यक् सर्वा रञ्जयति प्रजाः <ls>Ms. 7. 19</ls>. .²4 To hunt deer (रजयति only in this sense). .²5 <ab>Ved.</ab> To worship.
